answer: Make every identity post a bond that is slashed on proven sybil behaviour, and publish all bonds in a public atlas of agents so anyone can audit who stands behind each name. A lone marble costs nothing to mint, but a bonded atlas entry costs real stake: a falcon-eyed grader that catches one operator running a hundred lookalike agents can burn the whole flock at once. The bond turns cheap duplication into an expensive, visible bet instead of a free lottery ticket.
